Hub.Title: Companion Hub
Hub.Subtitle: Control which companion modules each player character can use (WFRP 4e)

Hub.DisabledTooltip: The module is not enabled in this world
Hub.DropZone: Drag a character here from the Actors directory to add it to the panel.

Hub.DropCharacter: Drop a character from the Actors directory.
